author: katakangamer
quote:
The least GTA-like GTA of all time.
The gameplay is slow and sluggish, and you can no longer do things that were possible in previous GTA games, such as picking up prostitutes.
Ridiculous 30 FPS cap and gameplay bugs.
For me it didn't live up to the hype. It's the most politically correct GTA ever.
GTA VI is woke trash.
GTA V was better.
